home.title_html: One platform for 2,000 institutes of vocational training, from the ministry to the student.
home.lede: Cursus connects the ministry, regional directions, institutions, instructors and learners. Attendance, grades, exams, administrative documents — all in one place.
home.roles_title: From ministry to student — a clear hierarchy.
home.roles_lede: Each role sees exactly what they need. Security is enforced down to the database (Row Level Security).
home.role_student_d: Courses, attendance, grades, exams, document requests.
home.role_teacher_d: Grade entry, exam management, attendance, course materials.
home.role_direction_d: Oversight of institutes within its zone.
home.feat_courses_d: Material uploads, organised by subject, access filtered by group.
home.feat_attendance_d: Present · Late · Absent — by session, by student, exportable.
home.feat_grades_d: Lectures, tests, labs, exams — average weighted by coefficient.
home.feat_exams_d: MCQ, open question, file upload. Built-in countdown timer.
home.feat_docs_d: Student request → admin processing → automated email delivery.
home.feat_rls_d: PostgreSQL Row Level Security. No role sees beyond its scope.
home.cta_band_lede: Cursus is built to deploy as-is. Configure Supabase, point your domain, activate your accounts.
